## Install
1. Download the extension ZIP below and extract it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` in desktop Chrome.
3. Enable **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked**, and select the extracted folder containing `manifest.json`.

## Open
1. Open [useradmin.comma.ai](https://useradmin.comma.ai), sign in, and open a device or route page.
2. Refresh the page if it was already open. The download controls appear on the page.
3. Click **Select DL Folder**, choose your filters, then click **D/L Route** or **D/L Routes**.
